snippet.title: I'll Invaligate your Aid: Foreaver - Reaveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Rea really doesn't want you to play. Are you sure you want to risk it?
"I'll Invaligate your Aid: Foreaver" is the upgraded version to the original game, featuring a redesign of the characters, new graphics, a battle minigame and much more content!
